lede: A D in the style of the old Cologne C, plus two more minimal versions, each as an uppercase D and a lowercase d in five colour schemes, from a large tile down to a round chat avatar and a 16px browser tab. Each has its own trademark screen.

concepts.name: Cologne-style D
concepts.idea: The uppercase D is the Cologne C mirrored into a bowl and closed with a straight stem; the C's hooks become rounded loops in the stem's corners. The lowercase d uses the Cologne C itself as its bowl, attached to a tall stem.
concepts.howItRelatesToC: Same doubled line, hairpin turns, crescent and stroke weight as the C. Watch-outs: the lowercase can look like a © sign at 24–40px, and at 16px the d's inner lines merge into a solid bowl.

upper.summary: Line-drawn Ds are common. The closest are Dailymotion's icon (a D with a second D line inside it) and Elegant Themes' Divi icon (an outlined D in a ring). Neither is in payments, and no payments or messaging brand found uses a double-line D.

closestMarks.name: Divi by Elegant Themes (product icon)
closestMarks.industry: WordPress theme and website builder software

lower.summary: The closest is Deliverect, restaurant ordering software whose icon is a green lowercase d, and it sells to the same restaurants. D-EDGE (hotel software) is also similar.

concepts.name: Minimal D
concepts.idea: Each letter is one round-capped line that never quite closes: the D runs down its stem, round the bowl and stops just short of the stem; the d does the same around its bowl.
concepts.howItRelatesToC: Keeps the C's round-ended line, its weight and its open, not-quite-closed mouth, without the doubled line. At 16px the small gap closes up.

upper.summary: Too close to OneDosh's registered D (US Reg. 8442961, registered Sept 2026 for payments and money transfer): a D drawn as one continuous curved line with a hook, inside a circle, which is how this D looks as a round chat avatar. I checked the registration myself.

closestMarks.name: Dojo (Paymentsense) site icon 'D'
closestMarks.industry: Card payments and POS for restaurants and hospitality

lower.summary: Reads as a plain rounded d; nothing found that copies it. The closest is Dayforce's lowercase d (payroll software).

closestMarks.name: Deliverect icon
closestMarks.industry: Restaurant online-ordering and delivery integration software

concepts.name: Most minimal D
concepts.idea: Each letter is just two round-capped strokes: a straight stem and a circular arc whose round tips rest on the stem. The uppercase is a stem with a reversed half-circle; the lowercase uses the Cologne C as its bowl on a tall stem.
concepts.howItRelatesToC: The C distilled to its round stroke and touching tips. It sits close to a rounded geometric font, so it is the least distinctive of the three.

upper.summary: Very close to Elegant Themes' Divi icon, a white single-line D inside a ring; as a round chat avatar this D looks almost the same. DEUNA (payments) is also similar.

lower.summary: Reads like the d of a rounded font; nothing found that copies it. The closest is Deel's 'd.' icon (payroll and payments).
